strNotes: Translation catalogs with English fallback; language selection through Phobos Framework. Shared native definitions, mass-balanced construction, inventory and physical item transfers, filters, clocks, grid routes and saved sender/receiver pairing. Requires BepInEx 5 and the PhobosFramework plugin. No Crafting Framework, Salvage Workshop or Shipbreaker dependency. Links persist in native saves; transport progress and scheduling remain the equipment mod's responsibility. Equipment economy: additive merchant stock, condition-aware offers, construction tools, mass-balanced service and dismantling. Ordinary saves supported; economy integration awaits gameplay validation. Version 0.8.0 adds shared immutable processing recipes, job revision/duration recovery and mass accounting.
